items.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
items.summary: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. items.summary: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. items.summary: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. items.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
items.summary: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. items.title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
items.summary: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. items.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. items.summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. items.summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. items.title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. items.summary: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). items.summary: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. items.summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. items.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
items.summary: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. items.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
items.summary: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. items.summary: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. items.summary: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. items.summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view.
